trophies.name: #UniteInSpeed
trophies.description: Collect all of the other trophies.

trophies.name: You Only Get One First Time
trophies.description: Complete your first Event.

trophies.name: Clubman
trophies.description: Join a Club, or have someone join a Club that you have created.

trophies.name: First Of Many
trophies.description: Beat your first Face-Off.

trophies.name: This One Is Mine
trophies.description: Customize a vehicle.

trophies.name: Contender
trophies.description: When the timer expires on a Driver Challenge, be at the top of the leaderboard.

trophies.name: And So It Begins!
trophies.description: Send a Challenge to another player.

trophies.name: Level Up!
trophies.description: Reach Driver Level 2.

trophies.name: 5 and Counting
trophies.description: Reach Driver Level 5.

trophies.name: Progress
trophies.description: Reach Level 2 with one Accolade.

trophies.name: Tonnage
trophies.description: Complete a point to point Event with an average speed of 100mph or 161 km/h.

trophies.name: Face-Off
trophies.description: Complete 50 Face-Offs.

trophies.name: On The Podium
trophies.description: Place in any of the top 3 positions during a 12 player race.

trophies.name: Nose To Tail
trophies.description: Draft another vehicle for at least 2187 yards (2000 metres) in a single event.

trophies.name: Team Work
trophies.description: Be a member of a Club that is Club Level 10 or above.

trophies.name: Rack 'em Up, Knock 'em Down
trophies.description: Beat 3 Target Times in a Single Time Trial event.

trophies.name: Long Distance
trophies.description: Drive for at least 300 miles (483 km).

trophies.name: Making Waves
trophies.description: Reach Driver Level 15

trophies.name: Life Begins
trophies.description: Reach Driver Level 30

trophies.name: Full House
trophies.description: Win a Race in each class of vehicle: Hot Hatch, Performance, Sports, Super and Hyper.

trophies.name: Unbeatable
trophies.description: Win 5 of your own Solo Challenges after sending them to at least one other player.

trophies.name: Mastery
trophies.description: Reach Level 6 with one Accolade.

trophies.name: Hoon-a-tic
trophies.description: Rack up 1 million drift points in total.

trophies.name: Cleanup
trophies.description: In a 12 player race, finish on the podium without losing any Fame due to collisions with other competitors.

trophies.name: Lifer
trophies.description: Drive at least 1000 miles (1610 km) as a Club Member.

trophies.name: Welcome To The Limit
trophies.description: Reach Driver Level 50

trophies.name: Credit Where It's Due
trophies.description: Reach Level 6 with one of each Gameplay, Game Mode, Vehicle and Event Accolades.

trophies.name: The Rookie Trophy
trophies.description: Win 'The Rookie Trophy' event in Tour on gold star difficulty.

trophies.name: The Amateur Trophy
trophies.description: Win 'The Amateur Trophy' event in Tour on gold star difficulty.

trophies.description: Win 'The Semi-Pro Trophy' event in Tour on gold star difficulty.

trophies.description: Win 'The Professional Trophy' event in Tour on gold star difficulty.

trophies.name: The Legend Trophy
trophies.description: Win 'The Legend Trophy' event in Tour on gold star difficulty.
